Read local OpenTelemetry trace files

Source: R/otel-local.R
read_otel_traces.Rd

read_otel_traces() reads GenAI spans from OTLP NDJSON files written by otelsdk's file exporter and groups them into conversations, ready for as_trajectory_otel(). This is where commons::agent(log = TRUE) and any ellmer or deputy application traced with OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp/file write their spans when they are not running on Posit Connect.

The exporter rotates through trace-0.jsonl, trace-1.jsonl, ... and keeps trace-latest.jsonl pointing at the newest file as a symbolic link, hard link, or copy. Each span is read once: files that resolve to the same path or have identical contents are read once, and a span that still appears in two files (a copy taken mid-write) is kept once.

Usage

read_otel_traces(
  path = NULL,
  n = 100L,
  from = NULL,
  to = NULL,
  max_spans = 50000L
)

Arguments

path

Trace files to read: one or more OTLP NDJSON files, or a directory of them. A directory contributes its trace.jsonl, trace-<n>.jsonl, and trace-latest.jsonl files, plus files named from the OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_FILE (or OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_FILE) pattern when one is set. NULL reads the directory of that pattern, and is an error when neither variable names a file.

n

Maximum number of recent conversations to keep. NULL keeps all.

from, to

Optional lower-inclusive and upper-exclusive bounds on the start time of a conversation's model calls, as for read_connect_traces(): a conversation is kept when one of its model calls started in the window, with all of its spans before to. Accepts POSIXct, Date, or ISO 8601 strings; a string without a zone is read as UTC. NULL leaves that side open. Unlike read_connect_traces(), the default reads every file in full rather than the last seven days.

max_spans

Ceiling on how many GenAI spans are kept, counting back from the most recent. Only spans carrying gen_ai.* attributes count towards it, as for read_connect_traces(); commons turn and provenance spans and Deputy run spans never count.

Value

A named list of conversations, each a list of spans, oldest-first, in the same form as read_connect_traces(). The "source_uri" attribute is a file:// URI when a single file or directory was read. The "read_info" attribute records the window, how many spans and conversations were found, whether the max_spans ceiling cut the read short (truncated), how many files were read (files), and how many lines could not be parsed (lines_dropped); incomplete is TRUE when any line was dropped.

See also

as_trajectory_otel() to convert the result, and read_connect_traces() for traces retained by Posit Connect.

Examples

path <- system.file("extdata", "otel-traces", package = "scans")
conversations <- read_otel_traces(path)
attr(conversations, "read_info")$conversations
#> [1] 1

bundle <- as_trajectory_otel(conversations)
trajectory_turns(bundle)[, c("trajectory_id", "role")]
#> # A tibble: 5 × 2
#>   trajectory_id  role     
#>   <chr>          <chr>    
#> 1 otel/support-1 system   
#> 2 otel/support-1 user     
#> 3 otel/support-1 assistant
#> 4 otel/support-1 tool     
#> 5 otel/support-1 assistant
